zh.title: 越竹航空停售機票 機隊僅剩三架
zh.summary: 越南越竹航空自8月1日起網站顯示國內主要航線「未找到航班」，機隊萎縮至僅三架飛機，其中僅一架A321投入包機營運，其餘航班均暫停。航空公司已致歉並啟動退款，同時累積大量代理訂金與客服投訴。
body: 越南越竹航空（Bamboo Airways）自2026年8月1日起，已實質停止銷售國內個別航班機票，官網在胡志明市－河內、河內－峴港及胡志明市－峴港等主要國內航線上均顯示「未找到航班」。
該航空公司機隊曾多達44架飛機，現已縮減至僅三架。根據《Airways Magazine》報導，這三架中僅有一架處於實際營運狀態。

目前唯一使用的飛機為一架註冊編號VN-A227的空中巴士A321-200，主要用於執行少數包機任務。其中一條包機航線為內港國際機場（DAD）至澳門國際機場（MFM），由旅行社承包整架飛機進行團體旅遊。航班QH9588於8月1日中午12:30自內港飛往澳門，另一次來回包機預定於8月20日執行，隨後該機將於8月22日執行最後一趟內港至河內航班，之後該航線的包機業務將全面停止。此後，航空公司尚未公佈任何航班計畫。
越竹航空已對受影響旅客公開致歉，並確認將提供機票退款。根據現行政策，透過官網、App或票務辦事處直接購買的機票，可在7至14個工作日內以電子代金券形式退款；若以電子郵件申請現金退款，在收齊所有所需文件後，最多可能需要90個工作日。透過第三方代理購票的旅客則須直接向原購票代理聯繫。多家票務代理表示，他們在越竹航空保留了數百億越南盾的押金，但未獲得明確的處理指引，近幾日也難以聯繫到航空公司。

根據越南民用航空局的數據，越竹航空2026年6月共營運725個航班，其中241個航班延誤，延誤率約為33%，在該月國內航空公司中準點表現最差。越竹航空創立於2017年，2019年1月16日首航，高峰時期曾擁有44架飛機，航線遍及國內外多個城市，包括墨爾本、悉尼、法蘭克福、倫敦蓋特威克機場（LGW）及倫敦希思羅機場（LHR），但所有國際航線均已終止。其困境可追溯至2022年母公司FLC集團倒閉及創始人鄭文決因詐欺罪被判刑入獄。

en.title: Bamboo Airways halts ticket sales as fleet shrinks to just three planes
en.summary: Vietnam's Bamboo Airways has stopped selling tickets for individual domestic flights since August 1, 2026, with its website showing no flights on major routes. Its fleet has shrunk to three aircraft, with only one Airbus A321-200 in active use for charter operations. The airline apologised and committed to refunds amid mounting agent and passenger complaints.
body: Vietnam’s Bamboo Airways has effectively stopped selling tickets for individual domestic flights since August 1, 2026, with its website showing “no flights found” on major routes such as Ho Chi Minh City-Hanoi, Hanoi-Da Nang, and Ho Chi Minh City-Da Nang.
The airline’s fleet, which once numbered 44 aircraft, has shrunk to just three, and according to Airways Magazine, only one of those three is currently in active use.

The sole active aircraft, an Airbus A321-200 registered VN-A227, is being used to operate a handful of charter flights, including a route between Da Nang International Airport (DAD)                                                                                  and Macau International Airport (MFM)                                                                                  under a travel company contract. Flight QH9588 departed Da Nang for Macau at 12:30 local time on August 1, 2026, with another round-trip charter scheduled for August 20, followed by a final Da Nang-to-Hanoi rotation on August 22, after which charter operations on that route are set to stop entirely. Beyond that date, the airline has not announced an operating schedule.

The airline has apologised to affected passengers and confirmed that ticket refunds will be issued. Under its current policy, tickets bought directly through its website, app, or offices may be refunded as an eVoucher within 7 to 14 business days, while cash refund requests submitted by email could take up to 90 business days once all required documents are received. Passengers who booked through third-party agents have been told to contact those agents directly, with several agents reporting they hold tens of billions of Vietnamese dong in deposits without clear guidance on handling.

According to the Civil Aviation Authority of Vietnam, Bamboo operated 725 flights in June 2026, of which 241, or roughly 33%, were delayed, placing it among the worst-performing domestic carriers for on-time performance that month. The airline was founded in 2017, launched its first flight on January 16, 2019, and at its peak operated 44 aircraft serving 20 domestic and 18 international destinations, including Melbourne, Sydney, Frankfurt, London Gatwick Airport (LGW) (LHR)                                                                                                                        , and London Heathrow Airport. All international routes have since been terminated, with its difficulties tracing back to the 2022 collapse of parent company FLC Group and the imprisonment of its founder, Trinh Van Quyet, on fraud charges.
